findings.title: Adding data does not apply the pending range
findings.description: Adding a populated series only changes `seriesCountRef`; it neither triggers a render nor changes this effect’s dependencies. Consequently, the existing Context range remains unapplied until the range changes again. The translation test masks this by calling `setRange` after `addSeries`. Trigger synchronization when data becomes available, and test adding data without changing the range.

findings.title: Series count does not establish data availability
findings.description: `addSeries` increments the count even for empty data, while `updateSeries` can clear data without adjusting it. Both cases leave the range effect’s guard open on an empty time scale—the condition it explicitly aims to avoid. Track actual data availability across add/update/remove operations and cover empty-series and cleared-data range changes.
